abstract: ABAC John Paul Sport Center has various type of sport facilities available for all teachers and students, so this department have a lot of data of court booking or facilities reservation in per day. From the research about the current reservation system of John Paul Sport Center, our team found that all the data now be collected in paper also we can check the status of all court only at the sport center that is uncomfortable for both user and staff. Our team want to solve this problem by creating the court reservation system on website which can check the court status, make the booking, and show analysis dashboard (available for the staff). Moreover, we want to make the system easier and more comfortable to access by the user and staff.

abstract: Greenhouse Plating is a system that help in agriculture and farming. It is monitoring and configurating the variable value such as temperature, light intensity, and soil moisture. The user can register and linked the system to the application, they can config the profile by fingertip. The smart greenhouse is a revolution in agriculture, creating a self-regulating, microclimate suitable for plant growth using sensors, monitoring and control systems that optimize growth conditions and automate the growing process. The user could make configuration and monitoring the crops via smartphone, moreover the system will cover the system notification that will notify the user when the system starts or stop working.

abstract: As students, one of the biggest hurdles in class is the ineffectiveness to learn the class materials from a classroom setting. Whether it is a problem with the teachers time or method of instruction, or the incapacity of fellow classmates to help. Oftentimes they turn to tutorship, only to find out that the broad offerings from tutors online varies in range and experience, costing them time and money for searches that often ends unsatisfactory. Au Tutify aims to provide students with tutors who have the precise experience that the students need. With Au tutify, the tutees would be able to see the exact course offered and choose only the tutors with the same experience on it.
